name: Groups tab lists nearby groups once location is known
description: With the phone's location set to London, the Groups tab moves past its loading message and lists both the Bluetooth nearby group and the local-area groups for that location.
details: A fresh user (location permission auto-granted at install; a deterministic London fix seeded via the new `location` step — ephemeral sims never acquire one on their own) opens Contacts → Groups: the tab must settle past 'Getting your location...' into the tier list — the Bluetooth mesh tier (contact-row:geohash:mesh, deterministic) plus the geohash location tiers (contact-row:geohash:gcpvj0d — the precision-7 geohash of the seeded fix, deterministic given the coordinates) — proving the location-dependent Groups surface resolves; the simulated fix is cleared in finally. Without a fix this surface hangs indefinitely (useLocationTiers has no timeout and even the fix-independent mesh tier waits — recorded product finding)
